body: claimed: M5 worker (issue-worker-max) · 2026-11-12T00:20Z · branch issue/882-adaptive-open-simplify · plan: simplify the cleared area and ring within the planner's working tolerance (one-sided, never outside the boundary) before the morphological opening; pin the bound and the cost; re-measure every adaptive fixture
Claim recorded for @mkinney - label and assignee set (only collaborators can set labels; your comment is the claim).

unclaim: M5 worker (issue-worker-max) releases #882 without a PR. This issue should carry `blocked` instead of `claimed` (I cannot set labels from the fork; a maintainer please swap it).

**Held work:** branch `issue/882-adaptive-open-simplify` on mkinney/Camcraft, commit 70ac996f (cut from upstream/main f490458a). No PR opened. The decision record is `docs/decisions/882-adaptive-open-simplify.md` on that branch.

**The fix works for the bore.** `rings::open` thins its area with Douglas-Peucker at `ARC_TOL` (0.25 um) and erodes 0.51 um deeper than it dilates back, so the opening never leaves the area it opens. The whole heavy test `app pocket3d_hsm::the_users_bore_roughs_adaptive_level_by_level_and_verifies_clean` drops from **115.6 s to 2.2 s** (release, Apple silicon). Four unit tests pin the tolerance, the containment and the cost on their own fixtures; they pass, and clippy on `camcraft-motion` is clean.

**It is blocked because it makes other fixtures worse.** Release, every variant measured against main:

| thinning at the opening | bore test | 60 x 14 slot | island 60 x 40 | rotary pins |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| none (main) | 115.6 s | HSM, 15.7 % load | refused by #850 budget, rings | pass |
| 16 nm | 12.2 s | falls to Offset rings | refused, rings | 2 fail |
| 62 nm | 4.2 s | falls to Offset rings | posted at 94.6 % load | 1 fails |
| 0.25 um | 2.2 s | falls to Offset rings | posted at 94.6 % load | 1 fails |
| 0.25 um + 0.51 um inset (held fix) | 2.2 s | posted at 73.7 % load | refused after 136 revolutions | 2 fail |
| 0.51 um inset alone, no thinning | - | falls to Offset rings | refused, rings | 1 fails |
| 0.25 um, on PR #953 | 2.0 s | falls to Offset rings | refused, rings | 1 fails |

A 16 nm change of the rings is enough to change the slot's strategy, so no tolerance is neutral. Three planner decisions sit on a knife edge, and each needs its own fix before #882 can land:

1. **Microlift acceptance** (`adaptive/lift.rs`, `lift_returns`). The lifted plan is kept only if its worst reading is not above the spiral's own; both are read in half-degree steps. On main the slot reads 48.0 against 48.0 and is kept. Perturbed, the spiral reads 47.5, the lifted plan is dropped, the unlifted spiral fails the travel law and the slot falls to Offset rings. Not filed yet.
2. **#845 / PR #953.** Once thinning lowers the vertex count, the #850 budget stops refusing the island and its plan is posted at 94.6 % of D (optimal 14.6 %), with crossings and rapids in stock in the verifier. Main is protected from #845 only by the budget. On PR #953 the island was refused again in the one run measured.
3. **Rotary travel pins** (`rotary_adaptive`). Which developed levels are refused flips under every variant; in one, radius 5.6 is cut by rings without a note naming it. Not filed yet.

**The issue's premise is partly wrong.** The bore's outline reaches the planner with 287 and 445 vertices. The ~4,700 vertices a trial are made by the planner: every offset and opening adds join vertices to a smooth ring, and `piece` only merges those closer than 10 um. Thinning the area once at its source leaves every fixture bit-identical and the bore at 115 s, so the thinning has to be at the opening.

**Also found, separate from this change:** the bore test is red on upstream/main f490458a on this Mac. Two levels (Z 20.000 and Z 10.000) fall to rings for "crosses itself"; the test pins one. Not filed yet.

**Next attempt:** after the three fixes above, re-measure the table and take the "0.25 um + inset" row. `GEOM_MAX` will need recalibrating (slot 252 k -> 170 k vertices).

Follow-ups filed from the held attempt: #982 (microlift acceptance knife edge), #983 (rotary level falls back to rings with no note), #984 (bore heavy test red on main, macOS). #882 waits on #982 and on #845/PR #953. The held fix (branch issue/882-adaptive-open-simplify @ 70ac996f, bore 115.6 s to 2.2 s) is re-measured once those land. (M5)

claim by @mkinney withdrawn (unclaim comment) - issue is free again; swapped to `blocked` at the claimant's request: it waits on #982 and on #845/PR #953. Held work: branch issue/882-adaptive-open-simplify @ 70ac996f (mkinney/Camcraft) - bore 115.6 s to 2.2 s, re-measure once the blockers land.

Fact for this issue: knife edge 1 (microlift acceptance) has a fix in review, PR #1080 (#982) - a sliver left by the pieces' longer chords, not a rounding tie; the slot keeps its lifted plan under 30 of 30 sub-micron twins. That also settles the r6.2 half of knife edge 3 (those neck levels become HSM-planned; their plan quality is #1050). The rest of knife edge 3 is the #850 budget, filed as #1051. Knife edge 2 is PR #953. The held speedup here was not re-measured on top of #1080.
